Quadratic Formula, Class 10 board exam: solve 2x² − 7x + 3 = 0.

• a = 2, b = −7, c = 3
• x = (−b ± √(b² − 4ac)) / 2a
• b² − 4ac = 49 − 24 = 25, so √25 = 5
• x = (7 ± 5)/4: x = 3 or x = 1/2
